environmentProjectMapping.source: GitHub environment SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF variables, read with gh api; confirmed against connected Duindorpdoet Supabase projects

currentReadOnlyEvidence.databaseQuery: select clock_timestamp() as measured_at, current_setting('server_version') as postgres_version, current_setting('max_connections')::integer as max_connections, count(*)::integer as connections, count(*) filter (where state='active')::integer as active, count(*) filter (where wait_event_type='Lock')::integer as waiting_for_lock from pg_stat_activity where datname=current_database();

observability.method: Connected Supabase read-only log source counts and security/performance advisors
observability.limitation: Log record counts and generic index advisories do not establish error rate, saturation or the cause of slow RPCs. No blanket index or RLS changes were applied.

limitations: Low-load snapshots are not a capacity benchmark.
No current Realtime configuration, compute allocation or PostgREST pool size was returned by these read-only project/database tools.
Database max_connections and Realtime authorization connection_pool are different limits.
The PR40 candidate and the current deployed revision have different migration and application histories.
The full 254-identity hosted test stopped before joining WebSockets.
There is no measured production failure threshold at exactly 200 connections.
The 20 support observers exercise three admin RPCs, not the current group_viewer_snapshot screen.
The SDK test did not render 254 browsers or read automatically after every broadcast.
Prepared sequential logins do not establish simultaneous login capacity.
